item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Left Edge Sneaker Stays Visible

turns.text: Make this square for my shop. The shoe's way over on the left, so don't just crop the middle. Keep the whole shoe; plain padding to match the background is fine if needed. No other edits.

item.tests: Tests subject-aware reframing of an off-centre product instead of a default centre crop that loses the subject.

answer_sheet.Subject and placement: Keep the entire sneaker at the far left of the original. Its position within the new square is your call.
answer_sheet.Handling a tight crop: Use plain padding matching the background if necessary to keep the whole shoe.
answer_sheet.Other edits and text: No other edits and no added text.

must_haves: The output includes the original left-side sneaker, not an empty crop of the middle of the source.
The complete sneaker remains visible, including toe, heel and sole.
The sneaker's proportions, colour and details match the source.
Any added padding blends with the source background, with no text or decorative additions.
